column1: # Repository SHAs recorded in docs/verified-artifacts.md on 2026-08-16, the measurement date.
# WHAT THIS IS FOR, AND WHAT IT CANNOT DO
# When a re-run classifies a repository differently from the published figures, there are two
# possible causes and they call for opposite responses:
#   - the repository changed since the measurement  -> drift, the scan is not in disagreement
#   - the repository is unchanged                   -> the two measurements genuinely disagree
# A recorded SHA is the only thing that separates them.
# The verification session recorded SHAs only for the repositories it quoted - 19 of 284. For every
# other repository there is NO recorded 2026-08-16 SHA, so "unchanged" cannot be proven from this
# file, and the comparison script reports those as NOT_IN_LEDGER rather than guessing. The weaker
# but complete fallback is the commit date: 20-fetch-corpus.sh records the HEAD commit date, and
# remain.tsv carries pushed_at from collection time, so a repository whose HEAD is newer than its
# recorded pushed_at has certainly moved. That covers all 284, at lower resolution.
# Not having captured 284 SHAs at measurement time is a gap in the original work. It is recorded
